name: Life Simulation Plugin (AI-Driven)
name_zh-CN: 事件及人体模拟插件（AI驱动）
description: AI-driven life simulation: schedule, events, habits, holidays, and emotion judgment for human-like behavior
description_zh-CN: AI驱动的生活模拟：日程、事件、习惯、节日和情绪判断，实现拟人化行为

components.name: get_life_simulation_habits
components.description: Get personal habits information (speaking, behavior, interests, preferences)

features: AI-driven schedule generation (work, leisure, meals, daily routine)
Health status determined by random events and schedule
Habits from config or AI-generated based on personality
Holiday API integration for dynamic holiday detection
AI-driven emotion judgment based on multiple factors
Illness system: AI judges illness based on multiple factors
Auto-regenerate schedule based on health status
All prompts in config file (fully customizable)
Read-only physiological state data (cannot be modified by commands)
Configurable AI models (tool_use, planner, replyer, utils, vlm, voice, embedding, lpmm_entity_extract, lpmm_rdf_build)
Prompts loaded from config file (not hardcoded)
Tool component for LLM to access habits information

1.1.0: Prompts moved from hardcoded to config file
Added configurable AI models (tool_use, planner, replyer)
Optimized configuration file structure for better readability
All user-facing text now in Chinese (simplified)
Added detailed Chinese comments in config file
1.0.0: Implemented health status determined by events and schedule
Implemented editable AI prompts with well-designed defaults
Removed timed events (replaced by AI-driven schedule)
All dialogue is AI-generated, not fixed
Physiological state data is read-only (cannot be modified by commands)
